repos.description: Install action: every target, cache, version forms
CI action: each check against pass/fail fixtures
Dev action: boots one- and two-context fixtures with bynk dev
Book: chapter listings compile with the diagnostics they quote
Example template: the starter every new example begins from
Shop: four contexts over Service Bindings and events, with end-to-end scenarios
Guide: every chapter listing compiles, formats and builds
Compat board: collects the canary's results
Examples index: the org's Bynk projects and their compatibility
Status page: the org's live Bynk services, checked every five minutes
Playground: unit tests, every gallery example through the release's wasm compiler, and the share service
